After the counselling session, the kids choose their respective fields. However, they wonder if they can get admission to the same college.
After learning that the exam corrections have been severe, Daya's mother offers a solution. However, the solution causes a problem for Jethalal.
Jethalal gets forced to wear a sweater in the scorching hot weather. However, he is not supposed to tell anyone the reason behind it.
After he wears the sweater, Jethalal has to face many obstacles. Later, his day at work also starts to get affected.
After a long and tiring day, Jethalal prays that he does not bump into any society members on his way home.
While Jethalal struggles with his situation, Bhide also begins to worry about Tapu Sena's upcoming final exam results.
Jethalal is in a fix when everyone gathers at his house on learning about his condition. After everyone offers different solutions, Dr. Hathi gets ready to administer an injection.
As the oath is now known to everyone in Gokuldham Society, Daya's mother offers a solution that's even tougher to follow.
Tapu has a nightmare about getting only 40 percent on his exams. Soon, everyone has to spend a restless night after he calls them up one by one and tells them about his worries.
Everyone arrives at Bhide's house to check the exam results, but are anxious about the delay. Soon, Sunder arrives with some much-anticipated news.
Everyone applauds Bhide's teaching efforts for helping the children improve their results. Later, Jethalal and Champaklal get an important phone call.
Everyone returns to Gokuldham and is happy with the news about Kunal. Later, the kids get presents from their parents.
The Mehtas contemplate over the kids' college admissions. Meanwhile, Sonu tries a new experimental hairstyle.
The men and the kids eagerly discuss college admissions. Later, they rush to the college to check the first list.
After Tapu fails to make it in the first list, Bhide asks him to wait for the second one. However, they are shocked to learn that he will not get admission due to one mark.
Jethalal decides that he will get Tapu admitted in the same college as Sonu and Goli. He makes calls to all his friends asking for help while Tapu's friends worry about getting separated from him.
Just as Madhvi is about to throw Bhide's tape recorder out of the house, he intervenes. Later, Bhide goes on to explain the importance of the tape recorder in his life.
Jethalal tasks Bagha with the responsibility of fixing Bhide's tape recorder. However, things take an unexpected turn as Bagha drops the tape recorder on the floor and damages it.

Bhayankar asks Katili Pari to make sure that the players competing against Baalveer's team win.
When the fairies gradually lose their abilities, they realise something is wrong and speculate that Baalveer's weapon may have been taken. Later, Rani Pari utilises magic to find the offender.
Bhayankar Pari tells Nokili Pari and Katili Pari to steal Baalveer's wand and ensure that Baalveer's opponent team wins. Later, Katili Pari joins the opponent team as a coach.
Jethalal gets mad at Daya after her new shampoo ruins his hair. Meanwhile, Daya tries to find a solution to the problem.
Taarak Mehta decides to have some fun and tells Jethalal that his only option to get out of the problem is to go bald.
Goli and Gogi head to Taarak's house to check on him. Meanwhile, the women of Gokuldham Society go to the temple.
Taarak and Tapu Sena enjoy an extravagant feast. However, Taarak worries that Anjali will discover his lie.
